t: A reason given for not strutting
a: وَلَا تَمْشِ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ مَرَحًا ۖ إِنَّكَ لَن تَخْرِقَ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَلَن تَبْلُغَ ٱلْجِبَالَ طُولًا
p: Wa lā tamshi fi-l-arḍi maraḥā, innaka lan takhriqa-l-arḍa wa lan tablugha-l-jibāla ṭūlā.
m: And do not walk upon the earth exultantly. Indeed, you will never tear the earth [apart], and you will never reach the mountains in height.
uc: Recitation by Mishari Rashid al-Afasy, via Quran.com
